videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Carrick's Man Utd future to be decided at Wednesday meeting.
Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick's future will be discussed at a meeting in Monaco on Wednesday.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Hill gets first England call-up as Konsa cover.
Bournemouth defender James Hill is added to the England squad for Thursday's Nations League match against Croatia at Wembley.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Cast your vote for BBC Women's Footballer of the Year 2026.
Voting is now open for the BBC Women's Footballer of the Year 2026, with five players on the shortlist.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Wales call up MK Dons' Collins as Moore withdraws.
Wales have called up MK Dons striker Aaron Collins for this month's Nations League matches following Wrexham frontman Kieffer Moore's withdrawal due to injury.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

How Germany's greatest goalscorer is guiding the next generation.
Miroslav Klose rose from amateur to World Cup winner as a player - now the German is forging a similar path as a coach.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

videos.title: Actualidad internacional
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Actualidad internacional.

Wenger considers standing against Infantino.
Former Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger is considering standing against Gianni Infantino as a candidate in Fifa's presidential election in March.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Dortmund fans' group criticises Nmecha celebration.
A Christian group set up for footballers says it wants to "demonstrate love and respect towards everyone" following criticism from fans.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Who are the main candidates for the Aberdeen job?.
Two domestic names stand out, while there is also the possibility of a foreign appointment following Stephen Robinson's departure.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Kompany back at Bayern training after collapse.
Bayern Munich say head coach Vincent Kompany is "on the road to recovery" following his recent collapse and treatment in hospital.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

People don't know full story behind England exile - White.
Arsenal defender Ben White says people don't know the "full story" behind his decision to previously make himself unavailable for England selection - but says he would make the same decision again.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes.
Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

The fans at the foggy FA Cup game no-one could see.
Thick fog left Notts County fans unable to see parts of the Magpies' FA Cup win over Altrincham.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Brady ends association with Birmingham City.
NFL legend Tom Brady ends his association with top-of-the-table Championship side Birmingham City after three years.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Atletico target Zubimendi move - Tuesday's gossip.
Arsenal midfielder Martin Zubimendi is a target for Atletico Madrid, Leeds United plan to step up contract talks with striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Barcelona are keen on Bayern Munich defender Jonathan Tah, plus more.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Savage denies media work is impacting role as manager.
Robbie Savage rejects criticism that his work as a co-commentator and pundit is impacting his role as Peterborough United boss.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
